hypothesis: Sampling the same quality-gated RGB-D estimator every six control ticks and composing SE3 within each action improves correspondence continuity compared with measuring only at VLM decision boundaries.
comparison: H11 original start: 0 prefix, 15 decisions, 361 controls, official false, head RGB-D quality stop; preserve H10/H11 failures.
quality_bounds: Unchanged 25 inliers, 0.45 fraction, 1px median reprojection, 15mm median depth residual and 0.18m/0.30rad/0.035m motion bounds; full-action bounds and original 12mm/2deg action residual remain.
failure_rule: Any failed segment or interrupted action invalidates the complete chain; no partial-motion credit, no velocity fallback, no retry solver. Preserve hard servo stops and final safe hold.
evidence: Every head RGB-D/q/hash substep saved; exact end snapshot at same control/q/gripper reused once for complete-action delivery; detailed chain excluded from model prompt.
rejected_cpu_alternatives: Individual wrist RGB-D lacks sufficient world support at H11 failure.
Pooled cameras can hide head reprojection >1px; not deployed.
Global KLT passes old geometry but has concentrated support; not deployed.
Spatial KLT plus joint RGB/depth consensus still fails two of 61 saved pairs; not deployed.
stop_conditions: Missing final sample or inconsistent control/frame/FK chain
limitations: More short measurements do not certify accumulated accuracy
No intermediate-depth replay is available for the old failed episode
New physical block must be registered after CPU/review; no unchanged rerun
